title: The Rite
subtitle: A flag you carry, and what it opens
description: The first quest hands out a stage -- a named flag, granted by a reward,
a command, or a script -- and the second asks for it. The second does not
depend on the first: there is no arrow between them, because the gate is
not a prerequisite. It is an overlay the server applies per player, which
is why a marked player and an unmarked one in the same party see the same
The third quest takes the stage away again, because a flag a pack can set
is a flag a pack can clear -- and a chapter that opens a door should show
